CustomField.description: Leave this blank to apply the target to every caller. Set it to the handler class that an API setting names, spelled the same way, to limit the target to that service's API calls and API issues. A target with a class name here never masks any other object, and never masks log entries.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave blank for every caller. Enter the handler class that your API setting names to limit the target to that service's API calls and API issues.
CustomField.label: Caller Class
